What works well is the contextual awareness. It picks up on what you are building and makes suggestions that fit the existing codebase rather than generating generic snippets you still have to rewrite anyway.

For anyone who does a lot of repetitive coding tasks or needs to ship quickly without a large team, this is a genuinely useful tool. It handles the boilerplate so you can focus on the logic that actually matters.

Still some rough edges in edge case handling, but the core experience is solid and the direction is right.

No-Code AI Agent Builder

Contral is the agent that teaches you while you build. Most developers study tutorials that have nothing to do with the code they actually work on. When they open their editor, they are on their own. Contral lives inside your existing environment and fixes that. Build Mode gives you context aware assistance as you write real code, supporting your thinking instead of replacing it. Learn Mode guides you through actual tasks with real time explanations tied to your editor. No new tools.
